scope: First-session online prayer verification privacy prompt from NVDA+Shift+P only
rootCause: Build 0.5.3.5 called synchronous wx.MessageBox directly from the global gesture callback. prePopup/postPopup made the prompt audible, but the callback remained blocked inside the modal call and NVDA could not dispatch the user's keyboard input normally.
fix: The one-press command now schedules the existing action with wx.CallAfter. Only its first-session privacy branch uses a non-modal keyboard-accessible wx.Dialog; the settings button retains its existing wx.MessageBox path. The dialog brackets its lifetime with prePopup/postPopup, defaults to No, maps Escape to No, and continues through the existing verification worker after Yes.

realNvda.computerUse: Unavailable because the trusted Windows helper failed with an ACL error; the real NVDA process used an isolated add-on profile and wx.UIActionSimulator to send the actual global shortcut and keyboard navigation.
